newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX ends bourse at record closing high.
newsitem.headline: German DAX ends bourse at record closing high.

text.p: The firm dollar lifted German shares to fresh record heights on Wednesday, with the DAX share index gaining more than one percent to end the bourse session at an alltime high close.

Also boosted by firm German debt after news of an unexpected slide in German December manufacturing orders, the DAX ended at 3,098 points, up 30.94 points or 1.01 percent, a whisker away from 3,100 point-level which would have given the market a strong psychological boost.

"There is strong support there from the dollar and the focus is very much on individual stocks, although the chemical sector is strong because of the dollar. The specific interest this morning is on Lufthansa," said one trader.
In early post-bourse screen trade, the IBIS DAX finally made it past the 3,100 hurdle to trade at 3,106.26 points at 1330 GMT.

Deutsche Lufthansa AG was one of the main gainers over the course of floor trade, although shares in the airline ended the session slightly off early highs at 23.38 marks, an increase of 1.23 marks or 5.55 percent.
The advance followed a series of restructuring announcements by Lufthansa, which dealers said lifted its stock past key technical resitance levels, prompting more buying interest.

Lufthansa plans to create a separate division for passenger services from April 1 in addition to reducing management and administration by a minimum of 10 percent, in response to the April 1 liberalisation of the European airline industry.
The stronger dollar particularly lifted chemical stocks, which were among the main leaders in early floor trade. The sector also saw significant volumes.
BASF AG ended bourse up 1.23 marks at 60.74 marks, Bayer AG ended up 2.58 marks at 64.68 marks, while Hoechst AG also ended strongly ahead, up 2.25 marks at 71.40 marks.
Shares in Metro AG ended up 2.85 marks at 128.45 marks after the retailer said 1996 group sales were unchanged at 62 billion marks and it expected at least one billion marks in profit.
